summary: capture a camera image, take a photo, snapshot, frame grab, inspect what the mobile robot or drone sees
description: Captures one image from the robot camera and prints the saved image path plus basic frame metadata. Output may include lines such as 'snapshot saved: /tmp/camera_001.jpg width=1280 height=720'. Report the saved path, timestamp, camera name if present, and any obvious error such as no camera feed. Does not accept parameters.
